artifact.canonical_name: Repowise evidence-backed codebase intelligence and benchmark method

sources.title: Repowise project, benchmark, report, and reproduction authority (bound Discovery source)
sources.role: Bound Repowise project and benchmark repository source record; project identity, methods, and measurements remain project-reported.

claims.text: The Repowise repository describes an evidence-backed codebase-intelligence tool for humans and AI agents that indexes code, call graphs, Git history, tests, and architectural decisions and returns cited context, blast radius, test impact, and code-health information.
The project describes core analysis as local and deterministic, with optional LLM synthesis as the only LLM layer, and documents MCP and CLI repository-intelligence surfaces.
The Repowise benchmark repository describes pinned repositories, commits, tasks, prompts, raw outputs, extractors, and retained losing rows for retrieval and agent-loop comparisons.

The Flask v3 report compares paired bare and Repowise arms on short read-only questions and longer Bash-enabled investigations, including tool calls, files read, cache-read tokens, cost deltas, and judge scores.

The reproduction instructions describe byte-identical prompts, environment-isolated bare-agent controls, deterministic gold-span grading for the retrieval split, and explicit adoption and judge-agreement checks.
The bound repository and benchmark materials do not state a single qualifying W33 publication or release date for the project or its reported runs.
claims.context: Absence of a date in the bound source set is retained as a chronology limitation.

limitations.text: The benchmark materials report small samples, including n=6 short tasks and n=5 long tasks, and describe the results as directional.
limitations.context: Sample-size limitation documented by the project.

limitations.text: The materials document judge noise, including a 0.69-point disagreement noise floor on django and a paired-delta standard deviation of 2.23 on one arm; judge-score differences are not a general quality result.
limitations.context: Measurement limitation documented by the project.

limitations.text: Prompt-caching sensitivity affects absolute cache-write and cost values; the project presents tool calls, files read, and cache-read tokens as more robust within the reported setup.
limitations.context: Caching limitation documented by the project.

limitations.text: The retrieval and agent-loop results are scoped to pinned repositories and tasks, including django/django or pallets/flask at one commit, and do not establish general task success or quality equivalence.
limitations.context: Repository/task-scope and interpretation limitation documented by the project.

limitations.text: Some hosted rows require subscriptions, API keys, or other credentials, and the checkout alone does not reproduce every reported row; no independent rerun is claimed in this card.
limitations.context: Credential and reproduction limitation documented by the project.

limitations.text: A qualifying W33 event or publication chronology remains unresolved in the bound source set; that limitation supports a later non-material editorial disposition and is not treated as proof of a W33 event.
limitations.context: Chronology boundary retained for downstream use.
